description: A modern C#-like language and zero-cost 2D framework for Game Boy, NES, Master System and Game Gear
releaseNotes:
# Changelog 0.0.1254

## Changes since v0.0.1246

- Tilemap.Set and Fill with a 16x16 or 32x32 tileset put the whole tile on the tileset's grid (#2373) (#2394) (`77d778ea`)
- SMS/GG: setup cells set after a scene's load show over its map, as on GB and NES (#2375) (#2393) (`86321d16`)
- A setup call outside the setup fails the build naming the call, on every target (#2380) (#2392) (`d67a4607`)
- A wrong option or a missing option value ends in one line that says what to write, never in a stack trace (#2384) (#2390) (`c73ed5a3`)
- byte, sbyte, ushort and short work as u8, i8, u16 and i16 wherever a type is written (#2388) (#2389) (`a29480a4`)
- The first picture of a followed scene is already on its target (#2387) (`e6d3c939`)
- retrosharp debug install registers the debugging MCP servers, and the guide asks for them before the first code (#2376) (#2386) (`fd89d8a8`)
- Tilemap.Set with a run-time argument in Start writes its cell at run time, in source order (#2369) (#2385) (`87b95335`)
